pages.title: Overdrive
pages.text: $(l)Uncommon$() prints at exact $(l)break-even$(); $(l)Rare$() prints at a $(l)profit$() — you get back more filament than you spent.

pages.title: Experience
pages.text: A catalyzed print stores XP on the machine, furnace-style. Pull the finished disc from the output slot and the orbs are yours. A big build with a Rare resin is worth roughly a level 0-to-30 jump.

pages.title: Treasure vs Quartermaster
pages.text: $(l)Treasure$() drops rare loot into printed chests, barrels and shulkers. $(l)Quartermaster$() instead stocks $(l)useful$() things: fuelled furnaces, a ready brewing stand, and a move-in kit with enchanted iron tools.
